target: Build a runnable demonstration of memory evaluation using a dated memory test with corrections. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Implement memory evaluation — human review
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of memory evaluation using a dated memory test with corrections. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.artifact: a dated memory test with corrections

competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a dated memory test with corrections.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report precision, temporal validity and abstention with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: grading against stale ground truth.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of memory evaluation.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report precision, temporal validity and abstention against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for grading against stale ground truth; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
